name: executors
description: Dispatch delegated Lead and Executor threads on the calling Director's Codex app-server.

interface.shortDescription: Run a configured Lead or Executor on the Director's runtime
interface.longDescription: Adds lead_dispatch for Directors and executor_dispatch for Directors or delegated Leads. The two supported routes are Director to Lead to Executor and direct Director to Executor. Each operation binds the verified caller, uses the configured route, allocates the existing worktree pool, and starts the child on the same app-server. One shared plugin server serves every role; per-session tool visibility is enforced by the installed MCP server, not by separate plugin identities.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch this prepared change to a configured delegated Lead
Dispatch this assignment to a configured Executor
